OUTPUT.description: Folder that transcript writes run-record.json and transcript.jsonl to.

OSF_DATA.description: Folder where run records every session as sessions/<session ID>.jsonl and Claude Code keeps its settings, in claude/.

OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.description: Resource attributes of the run as key=value pairs, set by the launcher, for example osf.run.id=…,osf.work_item.id=…,osf.factory.version=…. run keeps them with each session; transcript writes them into the run record.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: The service.name of the run record. Default: harness-claude-code.

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Anthropic Messages API that Claude Code calls, for example the inference gateway. Default: Anthropic's API.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: A token of claude setup-token: Claude Code runs on the subscription of the person who made it, in place of an API key.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: The key Claude Code sends to the model API, for example a gateway key or a placeholder that the egress proxy replaces. With CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN set, the adapter sends this key to the gateway as x-litellm-api-key instead, so that Claude Code runs on the subscription (ADR 0080).

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS.description: Extra headers that Claude Code sends with every model call, one "name: value" per line. On a subscription, the adapter adds the gateway key's line to them.

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.description: The model Claude Code asks for, for example claude-sonnet-5-5. Default: Claude Code's default model.

OSF_EFFORT.description: The effort level of the session's model, set by the launcher (ADR 0078). The adapter hands it to Claude Code as CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL. Default: Claude Code's default for the model.
